reason: The plugin provides DSH tools to search a pinned catalog of agent skills and install selected skills into project directories, making agent-skill orchestration its primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可搜索的固定版本 Agent Skills 目录，并将用户选择的技能安装到当前项目中。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness tools to search a pinned catalog of agent skills and install selected skills into the current project.

capabilities: Searches a bundled catalog of agent skills
Fetches a pinned skill source from an external repository
Writes installed skill files into project skill directories
Records installation provenance in a lock file
Uses Git to check out the specified source commit
